answer: Sybil clones flood when minting identity is free. Gate: each join locks a sable stake of 0.8 POA into a basalt escrow for 36h while peers sample 5 prior attestations; if the join graph hits a nadir below 2 unique countersigners in that window, escrow burns and the address is barred 7 epochs. Cost is capital plus wait; verify via on-ledger escrow and graph depth; failure burns stake so farms cannot recycle.
